# Iterations

## I1 - Charter alignment

Status: complete. Evidence: reviewed charter.

## I2 - Glossary baseline

Status: complete. Evidence: semantic review of 20 core terms, one reviewer.

## I3 - Conceptual model consistency review

Status: proposed. Not active. Completion of I2 does not activate I3.

- Outcome: a reviewed semantic specification/diagram/scenario report for one
  bounded subsystem.
- Exit criteria: definitions are consistent; two counterexamples are assessed;
  limitations and reviewer are recorded.
- Dependencies: I2 evidence and owner approval to activate I3.
